headline: The Election Commission of Pakistan on Thursday decided to hold the first phase of local government elections in Punjab on Feb 7, 2027, in view of fog and weather conditions, while polls in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa were postponed until further orders, Dawn reports.

card.desc: KP mein elections agle hukum tak rok diye gaye

caption:
Punjab mein local government elections 7 February 2027 ko!
Dawn ke mutabiq Election Commission of Pakistan ne Thursday ko faisla kiya ke Punjab mein LG elections ka pehla marhala fog aur mausam ki wajah se 7 February 2027 ko hoga. KP mein local government elections agle hukum tak rok diye gaye hain.
Kya aap apne ilaqe ke LG elections mein vote denge? Comment mein batayein 👇
